title: Page builder

fields.label: Page modules
fields.name: page_builder
fields.instructions: Add, remove and reorder page sections.

sub_fields.label: Badge
sub_fields.name: hero_badge
sub_fields.instructions: Small label above the heading, e.g. "Support".

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: hero_title
sub_fields.instructions: Page H1. Defaults to "How can we help".

sub_fields.label: Popular articles
sub_fields.name: popular_articles
sub_fields.instructions: Optional quick links under the search box. Three or four works best.

sub_fields.label: Links
sub_fields.name: links
sub_fields.instructions: Submit a request / My requests / Help centre pick up their URL from Support → Settings automatically.

sub_fields.message: Shows the logged-in client's requests, or a login form. Set this page as "My requests page" in Support → Settings so email links land here. Use a Page header module above it for the H1.

sub_fields.label: Intro
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Shown above the request list (not on a single request).

sub_fields.message: Outputs the request form from the Support Desk plugin. Set this page as "Submit a request page" in Support → Settings. Support hours come from Site settings.

sub_fields.label: Tips
sub_fields.name: tips
sub_fields.instructions: Shown under "To help us fix it faster".

sub_fields.label: Section Tag
sub_fields.name: section_tag
sub_fields.instructions: Optional eyebrow label, e.g. 'Last updated: January 2026'.

sub_fields.label: Content Width
sub_fields.name: content_width
sub_fields.instructions: Reading width suits long text such as policies. Full container fills the page width.

sub_fields.label: Heading level
sub_fields.name: heading_level
sub_fields.instructions: Use H1 only when this block is the first thing on the page (no page header module above it).

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Its level is set by Heading level above.

sub_fields.label: Content
sub_fields.name: body_content
sub_fields.instructions: Full content. Supports headings, lists, tables, links, and blockquotes.

sub_fields.label: FAQ Items
sub_fields.name: faq_items
sub_fields.instructions: Add each question and answer pair.

sub_fields.label: Answer
sub_fields.name: answer
sub_fields.instructions: Supports basic formatting, lists, and links.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.placeholder: Meet the people behind the work.

sub_fields.label: Intro Text
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Optional introductory paragraph below the heading.

choices.all: All team members (in Team menu order)

sub_fields.label: Team Members
sub_fields.name: team_members
sub_fields.instructions: Select team members to display. Drag to reorder.

description: Support Desk page builder: one layout per page module.
